TITLE: Script Orbits
DESCRIPTION: Four orbs on springs, pushed around by a script.js physics loop: they circle to the music and are kicked off their orbits on every bass hit (or the Kick button). The orb positions arrive through the orb1-orb4 controls the script writes; the spectrum runs along the bottom edge. Scripted tier: a feedback pass plus JavaScript.

CONTROLS.NAME: pull
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How hard the orbs are pulled back to their orbit.

CONTROLS.NAME: chaos
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How hard a kick throws them.

CONTROLS.NAME: kick_orbs
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Throw the orbs, as a bass hit does.
